html:
NeuFlow v2 (Northeastern University, 2024): a small and fast optical-flow network built for edge devices: a light CNN backbone, global matching at 1/16 and a few cheap refinements at 1/8. Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Paper: NeuFlow v2: Push High-Efficiency Optical Flow To the Limit, arXiv, 2024-08-19
  • Original code: https://github.com/neufieldrobotics/NeuFlow_v2 at 204b5e374446
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/Study-is-happy/neuflow-v2/blob/79ae2f4589456d4d369aaef4955c7db5918c3436/README.md
  • Training data: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), MPI Sintel optical flow, KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015, HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark (README: "trained with multiple datasets" (not listed); the mixed stages of upstream's data_utils/datasets.py use FlyingThings3D (part of SceneFlow), Sintel, KITTI 2015, HD1K and, in one stage, VIPER)
    • neuflow-v2-sintel: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), MPI Sintel optical flow, KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015, HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark (FlyingThings3D (part of SceneFlow), then upstream's 'sintel' stage: Sintel, KITTI 2015, HD1K and FlyingThings3D)
    • neuflow-v2-things: Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa) (FlyingThings3D (part of SceneFlow), upstream's 'things' stage)
  • Options: iters = 8 (>= 1)
  • Kernel libraries: raft_flow
  • Variants: neuflow-v2, neuflow-v2-sintel, neuflow-v2-things
  • Outputs: flow
  • Input size: any H x W >= 32, padded to a multiple of 16
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): neuflow-v2 1024x2048 (8.2 GiB peak allocated, 9.0 reserved); neuflow-v2-sintel 1024x2048 (8.2 GiB peak allocated, 9.0 reserved); neuflow-v2-things 1024x2048 (8.2 GiB peak allocated, 9.0 reserved)
  • neuflow-v2 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 29 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 104 s (ONNX + engine).
  • neuflow-v2-sintel 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 29 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 102 s (ONNX + engine).
  • neuflow-v2-things 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 29 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 104 s (ONNX + engine).
  • neuflow-v2 original (fp32) 1080x1920: upstream NeuFlow, iters_s8=8
  • neuflow-v2 original 1080x1920: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); upstream NeuFlow, iters_s8=8, infer.py recipe: conv-bn folded, model.half()
  • neuflow-v2-sintel original (fp32) 1080x1920: upstream NeuFlow, iters_s8=8
  • neuflow-v2-sintel original 1080x1920: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); upstream NeuFlow, iters_s8=8, infer.py recipe: conv-bn folded, model.half()
  • neuflow-v2-things original (fp32) 1080x1920: upstream NeuFlow, iters_s8=8
  • neuflow-v2-things original 1080x1920: the authors' mixed-precision option (float16); upstream NeuFlow, iters_s8=8, infer.py recipe: conv-bn folded, model.half()
  • neuflow-v2 load / first call: original 0.2 s / 0.223 s, portable 0.05 s / 0.303 s (375x1242), kernels 0.96 s / 0.179 s (375x1242)
  • neuflow-v2-sintel load / first call: original 0.17 s / 0.076 s, portable 0.07 s / 0.283 s (375x1242), kernels 0.95 s / 0.178 s (375x1242)
  • neuflow-v2-things load / first call: original 0.17 s / 0.076 s, portable 0.06 s / 0.297 s (375x1242), kernels 0.92 s / 0.182 s (375x1242)
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Frames _10 -> _11 at full size against the flow_occ ground truth; EPE = mean of the per-pair mean end-point error, Fl-all = share of all valid pixels with an error > 3 px and > 5 % of the GT magnitude. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.0001 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.0014 and p99 <= 0.0067 (absolute error of the output flow).
